gear.why: Author: total skill amp 72% with this

mechanics: Chardonnay gives a 120% crit-rate buff instantly to the whole team, which replaced Macaron and removed the need to manage positions
Pomegranate starts the fight with the base 3 beams; extra beams come later via the volley synergy

Milk and Chardonnay receive Pomegranate's beam first (Chardonnay as a '탄속' cookie); the third goes to the highest-ATK cookie, which should be Seeker so her opening drones are made with Chardonnay's full crit buff
Tiger Lily is kept despite Chardonnay's own volley synergy because she provides 다발 3
Cheesecake before Tea Knight in ATK order so Cheesecake gets skill amp and Milk's own ATK rises further
Guild score rose by 124G 144M on a 3.384T run, which suggests only the improvement over the personal best counts (extractor's reading of the result screen, not stated)
disagreements: 필립쓰 thought only the six beam recipients matter, with the rest lowered; author: the order matters because the first beams in the opening 60 s go by ATK rank
